description: Fetch comments on one TikTok video: username, text, create_time, like_count, reply_count and parent_comment_id for replies. Give exactly one of `url` or `id`. Costs 3 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

limit.description: At most this many results, 1–50. A page can hold fewer while `next_cursor` is set: read until it is null.

url.description: The video URL, `https://www.tiktok.com/@…/video/…`. A short `vm.tiktok.com` link is not read: open it, and copy the address it leads to.

name: get_tiktok_comments
title: Get the comments on a TikTok video
